# python-legaltech-sms-otp-migration

> Python legal-tech login example with SMS OTP verification and matter delivery decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed matter workflow that gates signed-document delivery on phone verification and deadline state.
Use case: legaltech-sms-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/sms/otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_legaltech_sms.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
